label: FACIS DSP — Consumer Ingest
info:
POST /dsp/ingest (NF-2 / FR-DL-001 consumer side). Given a
provider base URL, an already-negotiated agreementId, and an assetId,
drives that provider's own /dsp/transfers endpoint, follows the returned
access object, pulls the data, and lands it in this instance's OWN Bronze
layer via Kafka (dsp.ingest.raw → bronze.dsp_ingest, see Task 3).

Does NOT drive contract negotiation itself — negotiation
(POST /dsp/negotiations) is a separate, already-implemented phase; call
it first to obtain agreementId. Does NOT attach a VP to its own outbound
calls (DSP_IAM_ENFORCE=warn in the live deployment does not require one;
attaching one is a known follow-up, see orce/README.md's NF-2 section).

name: validate request, prep POST /dsp/transfers
validate transfer-create response, prep GET
validate transfer state, extract access.url
validate data-pull response, split into rows
build Bronze envelope + kafka msg + metric
